optimizer.acceptance: Original Q/wave/peak and all hard flags pass; additionally PSD and global objective decrease and continuous ADC margin risk does not increase.
optimizer.failed_trial: Restore parameters; if no trial passes also restore Adam state.

gradient_rule: Hard ADC/argmax/crop values remain bitwise exact. Add derivative of softmax over32 search codes at one-ADC-code temperature, times detached candidate windows. Existing selected-value derivative retained once.
endpoint_decision: Fresh two-bank32 primary PSD CDF improves >=10%, Q mass/wave/peak no worse by2%, flags do not increase. This is pilot advancement only, not original scientific acceptance.

operation_budget.derivation: 103440 normalization + 9*103440 first direction + 11*10*103440 later directions + 8*103440 endpoint =13240320.

storage.archival_policy: Active compute checkpoint and endpoint scalars needed for immediate analysis; no NAS probes or duplicate large backups.

initialize_from: One previously committed B update. First direction reuses job156 saved gradients and two direction tensors; later directions recompute gradients at current weights.

joint_rule.secants: Native probes at the SAME local radius for all directions; clipping occurs before measured secants. First radius0.05 rounds down the smallest rejected wave coefficient0.05163 from job157.
joint_rule.solver: Linear program in convex hull of zero and the up to4 local actual probe displacements, with unchanged simultaneous constraints.
joint_rule.constraints: Q_mass <=+0.5%, waveform <=0%, peak_codes <=+1%; PSD_CDF and each-bank continuous ADC margin risk nonincreasing.
joint_rule.ADC_margin: Mean per-row squared positive rail proximity in ADC codes; margin starts one code inside both physical rails, using actual pre-ADC min/max over384 samples.
joint_rule.validation: Hard evaluate combination at scales1,.5,.25; commit only if original guards, all flag counts, continuous rail risk, strict PSD improvement and strict total objective decrease pass.
joint_rule.optimizer: Adam moment update is retained only when the jointly selected step commits. Rejected weights and moments are restored.
joint_rule.limitation: Native secants are local approximations, not guarantees across peak jumps; hard evaluation is decisive.
joint_rule.ADC_directions: Exact gradient of continuous pre-ADC margin risk for each TRAIN bank separately, mapped through original diagonal lr-squared metric and normalized to wave-direction metric norm. Omit exactly-zero hinge gradients.
joint_rule.trust_region: After a hard-accepted step, double its effective local radius only when actual/predicted total-objective reduction>=0.75; cap1. Otherwise retain effective radius. Rejection shrinks to smallest tested scale; same3-consecutive-rejection stop.
joint_rule.why: job157 continuous ADC risk increased even at the smallest combined step; adding a continuous ADC degree of freedom directly addresses that active conflict. Local secants address full-step prediction sign failures.

stop_rule: If first joint feasibility step fails, stop training immediately. Otherwise at most12 total directions, or stop after3 consecutive rejections. No budget extension or threshold relaxation.

measured_budget_basis.basis: Measured job157 on idle GPU took30.94s for1.55M rows; max13.24M rows plus continuous and global backward work. Reestimate after first accepted step.
